verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community hands-on report that kitty works with a zsh/tmux setup, but only after a few tweaks. No first-party documentation covers tmux compatibility or a native tmux control mode. Kitty's own tabs, splits, layouts and sessions are a different feature and are not credited as tmux integration. Missing for 10: first-party docs on tmux compatibility, any documented native tmux integration or control mode, details of the tweaks needed, and independent corroboration beyond one anecdote.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use tmux inside the terminal, or a documented native tmux integration/control mode
